title: Cops VS Resisting Duo: Entitled Women Scream At Officers & Resist Arrest!
description:
On February 25th, 2023, officers in Ohio were called to a neighborhood dispute over children playing.

Two women had been driving by when one of the women noticed their nephew and stopped to speak with him. The woman's nephew told her he had been playing with another child and had gotten into a fight. Upon hearing this, the two women approached the child’s mother and began arguing about her son. The child's mother called the police as two women argued with her.
 
Upon arrival, the officer spoke with the mother, who pointed to the two women in a nearby vehicle.  As the officer spoke to the mother, the two women approached the officer and began shouting. Despite the officer telling them multiple times to stop and get back inside the vehicle, the women continued shouting and refusing to comply. The officer warned the women they would be arrested if they did not stop, but they continued not to comply.  As the officer attempted to arrest one of the women, she resisted, leading her friend to intervene. After handcuffing her, another officer arrived to assist in detaining the second woman.

Both suspects were placed in patrol cars as officers spoke further with the child and his mother. After speaking with the child and his mother, the officer met with the suspect's nephew and parents to discuss what happened. After speaking with all parties, the officer began transporting the suspects to the police department for further processing. The suspects were both charged with Resisting Arrest and Disorderly Conduct.
